_why: R19 grading pass (2026-09-24): inbox-after-install's expect now also asserts the just-installed plugin's toggle reads OFF (aria-checked=false) — a new download starts inactive everywhere, no grandfathering. This used to only check that the setup panel opened, which passed even while the workbench fixture hardcoded the toggle on.

shots.name: inbox-after-install
shots.expect: js:document.body.textContent.includes('Choose where the assistant can use it automatically') && (()=>{const t=document.querySelector('[aria-label="Inbox in this project"]');return !!t && t.getAttribute('aria-checked')==='false';})()
